title: Finite tame normalization model near the root divisor generic point
statement: Let $i:U\to L$ be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $G$ a finite group and $W\to U$ a finite etale $G$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let $R$ be a commutative regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], $\varphi:\operatorname{Spec}R\to L$, and $f\in R$ a nonzerodivisor with $R/(f)$ regular. Suppose $|G|$ is a unit in $R$. Assume $\beta:U\times_L\operatorname{Spec}R\cong D(f)$ commutes with the projection to $\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}R$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], $H$ its canonical strict henselization coordinate-ring colimit [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], and $b:R\to H$ a map inducing its structural morphism [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map]. Put $g=b(f)$, $n_0=|G|$, $A=H[T]/(T^{n_0}-g)$, $N=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $q:N\to\operatorname{Spec}H$ the algebra structural morphism, and $V=D(g)\subset N$. Assume $g$ is not a unit. Then $N$ is locally Noetherian, and there exist a regular integral scheme $D$ [def-pc-integral-scheme], an effective Cartier centre $j:D\to N$ [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal] whose complement is $V$, a scheme $C$, and a finite morphism $a:C\to N$ [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], etale on $V$, with an open $O\subset N$ and a generic point $\eta\in D$ (its closure is all of $D$), such that $j(\eta)\in O$ and $a$ is etale on $O$. There is an isomorphism $\zeta:(a^{-1}V)\cong W\times_L V$ commuting with projections to $V$, where $V\to L$ is $V\hookrightarrow N\xrightarrow q\operatorname{Spec}H\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Spec}b}\operatorname{Spec}R\xrightarrow\varphi L$. No extension etale everywhere and no surjectivity of $a$ are asserted.

source.place: Tags 09EB (Galois degree formula), 0BRM (Abhyankar), 0EYG (strict henselization and root algebra through B′), and 0EYH (finite locally free tame normalization).

proof.text: Apply strictHenselization_regular_divisor_quotient for Noetherianness of H and regularity and integrality of H/(g). The retained upstream structural-flatness theorem strictHenselization_structural_ringHom_flat applies to b and hb. Flatness preserves the regular element f; the monic root algebra is finite free, so t^|G|=g proves its root t regular. Construct the ring equivalence A/(t) with H/(g) explicitly by evaluation at zero and constants. Transfer regularity and the domain structure. Put D=Spec(A/(t)), and let j be the quotient immersion. Its kernel is the ideal generated by regular t, so it is an effective Cartier centre. The prime-ideal power criterion proves its complement is V. Monic root finiteness proves N locally Noetherian. All of this is the explicit, complete proof in the retained upstream module.

Install integrality of D and choose its canonical genericPoint. Apply strict_hensel_root_tame_normalization to this D, j, its support equation, and generic point. It supplies the finite model, etaleness on V and on an open O containing the divisor generic point, and the comparison isomorphism over V with its projection equation. Reassemble these witnesses with the constructed divisor and Noetherianness.

theorem GaloisCover.strict_hensel_root_purity_data
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hf : IsSMulRegular R f)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})]
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (barY : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Spec R)
    (b : R ⟶ strictHenselization barY)
    (hb : Spec.map b = strictLocalizationToBase barY) :
    let H := strictHenselization barY
    let g := b.hom f
    let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial H) ^ Nat.card G - Polynomial.C g)
    let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
    let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap H A))
    let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap H A g)
    ¬ IsUnit g →
    IsLocallyNoetherian N ∧
      ∃ (D : Scheme.{u}) (j : D ⟶ N),
        IsRegular D ∧ IsIntegral D ∧ IsEffectiveCartierCenter j ∧
        (∀ z : N, z ∈ V ↔ z ∉ Set.range j) ∧
        ∃ (C : Scheme.{u}) (n : C ⟶ N),
          IsFinite n ∧ Etale (n ∣_ V) ∧
          ∃ (O : N.Opens) (η : D), IsGenericPoint η Set.univ ∧
            j η ∈ O ∧ Etale (n ∣_ O) ∧
          ∃ ζ : (n ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme ≅
              pullback (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ),
            ζ.hom ≫ pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (V.ι ≫ q ≫ Spec.map b ≫ φ) =
              n ∣_ V
